{{Quote|Different folks feel different ways. Me, I feel like getting paid, and that's all the feeling I need.|Garnt, when asked about the local attitude towards [[Nirama]]|<ref name="TopWorld">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: TopWorld}}</ref>}}
'''Garnt''' was the bartender of the [[Hutt's Tail]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. He was a grizzled [[Human/Legends|Human]] with a patch over his right eye, and communicated mainly with grunts.
